text:
carmen: Hey all — quick preflight for tomorrow's large soak run. Need a runbook sanity check + one perf regression to watch for. TL;DR: 50k virtual users, 6h steady, traffic replay of prod day-peak, KV cache warm=True. :eyes:

mike: copying the plan here. are we still using locust for the replay orchestration or k6?

carmen: locust for the user-behavior replay (session-level), k6 for synthetic burst tests. This run is locust + replay fixture from s3: s3://replays/2026-03-15/day-peak.tar.gz

sophia: perf regression to watch: tokenization step spiked last time when seq_len > 1024. Also watch CUDA mem alloc peaks on model-worker-2.

alex: noted. I'll add a guard to abort the run if model-worker-2 GPU mem > 92% for > 60s. Want the alert to slack #eng-oncall and create an incident draft.

mike: can we get a short checklist for infra ops? e.g., nginx conn limits, db pool, redis eviction policy, etc.

carmen: infra checklist (high-level):
- nginx: increase keepalive timeout to 75s for replay nodes
- db: set max_connections=250 for read-replicas during replay
- redis: eviction policy volatile-lru, preload prefix cache for replay keys
- k8s: set PodDisruptionBudget=0 for model-worker statefulset during run

mike: pinging infra to approve db change. @sophia can you sanity-check the redis preload script?

sophia: looking. Also add this to the postmortem hooks: collect flamegraphs from model-worker every 15m and upload to artifacts bucket. small snippet to collect: 
```bash
# on model-worker-2
perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 60
perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl > out.folded
/flamegraph.pl out.folded > /tmp/flame-$(date +%s).svg
aws s3 cp /tmp/flame-*.svg s3://artifacts/soak/$(date +%Y%m%d)/
```

alex: good. I'll wire up a quick CloudWatch -> Slack alarm for the GPU mem rule and a K8s liveness probe tweak to avoid constant restarts during heavy GC.

carmen: load profile: ramp 0 -> 50k in 30m, steady 6h, ramp down 10m. target p95 latency < 220ms for text-generation endpoints. If p95 > 400ms for > 2 consecutive 5m windows, we trigger rollback.

mike: where do you want the benchmark artifacts posted? we have the replay logs, flamegraphs, and locust stats.

carmen: put raw logs + locust-stats.csv in s3://replays/results/1987654321/ and drop a short summary in the run doc (link in #eng-runtime). I'll update post-run checklist.

sophia: small note: TTL on KV cache should be disabled for the duration of the run or we get cache churn. set ttl=0 on the replay namespace.

turing-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled soak-run job queued: soak-run-1987654321. Expected start: 2026-03-17T02:00:00Z. Notifications: #eng-runtime, #eng-oncall.

alex: one last ask — devs doing model changes, please pin model version to v2.3.1 for this run. No rolling model updates during the soak.

carmen: agreed. I'll post the pinned model in the run doc. Thanks everyone — final sign-offs? :thumbsup:

mike: :+1: all good from infra side, db change approved (will be applied 45m before run).

sophia: :thumbsup: redis script + flamegraph hook checked in to ops-repo.

alex: :thumbsup: alerts wired, will monitor during run.

carmen: perfect — closing preflight. will post start message 10m before kickoff.
